The science, made simple

Pressure sends oxygen where blood cannot.

One

Oxygen rides on red blood cells

  • Your body repairs itself with oxygen
  • It normally travels only where blood flows freely
  • Swollen, injured, tired tissue is exactly where flow slows down
Two

Pressure changes the rules

  • Inside the chamber, gentle pressure rises
  • Oxygen dissolves directly into the fluid of your blood
  • Not just the cells that carry it
Three

Repair gets its raw material

  • That fluid reaches what red blood cells struggle to reach
  • Your body gets more of the one thing every repair job runs on

Healing is work. Work takes energy. Your cells make that energy with oxygen. Recharge before you repair.

Compared to what you're already taking

You've tried the things you can't feel.

Capsules, powders, greens, trackers, cold plunges. You take them on faith, because you can't feel any of them working.

A supplement has to survive your gut before it reaches anything. Digest, absorb, circulate, then hope enough arrives where you actually need it.

Oxygen is different. It's what your body already runs on, and pressure puts it straight into your blood. Nothing to digest. Nothing to absorb. And you feel the session while you're in it.

Questions, answered straight

What everyone asks before booking

What happens in a session?
You lie back in the chamber for about an hour. The pressure feels like a plane taking off, then you relax, read, or nap. Our team is right outside the whole time.
Is it safe?
Every patient is screened by a physician first. Hyperbaric oxygen has real contraindications, and checking for them is part of the service, not fine print.
How many sessions will I need?
That's exactly what your consultation answers. Most plans run a few sessions a week over several weeks, built around your recovery.
Does insurance cover this?
No - this is a cash-pay wellness service. Your first visit is $147, and you'll know the full plan and cost before committing to anything more.
Do I need to stop training?
No - most athletes keep training around their sessions. Your consultation is where we map hyperbaric sessions around your training and competition schedule, not instead of it.
